spans.s: When an affix declaring the time of an Asterism is elided by लुप् -- लुबविशेषे

, the 7th and the 3rd case-affixes are used after the word, whose affix is also elided.

Terms: विभक्ति-3, 7
The affix अण् already ordained -- प्राग्दीव्यतोऽण्

, comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction which is the name of a lunar mansion, to signify a time connected with the asterism.

Terms: अण्

There is diversely लुक् elision of the affix denoting 'born therein' after an asterism.

Terms: लुक्

The affix घ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the word नक्षत्र without altering the meaning.

Terms: घ

ष् is optionally substituted for the स् when the preceding word is the name of a Lunar mansion.

Terms: षत्व change
